title: Playboy January 1987 Erte Cover Holiday Anniversary Issue Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear and a tiny nick at the top corner of the back cover. Complete with centerfold. Note: the Erte signature on the cover is printed as part of the artwork, not hand-signed. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 1987 - Holiday Anniversary Issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Art deco Rabbit Head cover illustrated by Erte (the signature is printed as part of the artwork).

Back cover: Salem Spirit Lights ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
